title: TransUNet: Transformers Make Strong Encoders for Medical Image Segmentation
layout_note: Panel (b): CNN encoder at top-left descends to the transformer stack and a reshaped bottleneck at the bottom, then the cascaded decoder climbs a diagonal staircase to the upper right; panel (a), the transformer layer, is a tall inset on the far left.
grouping: Panel (a) is a cream rounded container with a tan outline, tied to the green 'Transformer Layer' container in (b) by two grey dashed zoom lines. In (b) the CNN sits in a lilac rounded container and the transformer stack in a light-green rounded container with a saturated green outline. Each skip concatenation is a grey dashed square drawn around a purple (encoder) cube and a blue (decoder) cube. A text legend sits at the right edge.
shapes_depth: Feature maps are translucent 3-D cuboids: purple for CNN encoder features, light blue for decoder features, darker blue for the reshaped bottleneck. Layers in (a) are flat rounded rectangles in pastel fills (peach Layer Norm, yellow MSA, grey MLP) with circled '+' residual nodes. Hidden features are thin blue bars with downward tick arrows. Skips from the CNN are thin black dotted curves labelled 1/2, 1/4, 1/8. Tensor shapes like (256, H/8, W/8) are bold text under each cube. Input is a CT slice; output is a CT slice with coloured organ masks.
proposed_highlight: The transformer stack, the contribution, is the only container with a saturated outline (green) and is expanded into panel (a) through dashed zoom lines; encoder vs decoder features are told apart by purple vs blue cube tint, which carries into every concatenation box.
lesson: Tint encoder cubes and decoder cubes differently and draw each skip concatenation as a dashed box holding one cube of each tint, so every merge shows both of its sources without extra labels.
notes: Venue/year: arXiv 2021 (year = arXiv preprint year); no venue printed on the arXiv PDF (later extended as a journal paper). Legend entries are written in the colour of the arrow they explain.

core.what: the U is drawn as a down-then-up staircase in panel (b): a CT slice enters a purple CNN frame at the top left, features descend through Linear Projection into a green-framed stack of Transformer Layers (n = 12), reshape into a slab at the bottom, and the decoder climbs diagonally up to the right in four steps to a colour-labelled organ segmentation at the top right

relations.form: encoder reads top to bottom in one column (image -> CNN slabs -> Hidden Feature -> Linear Projection -> transformer -> Hidden Feature (n_patch, D)), then a 'reshape' arrow turns right and the decoder slabs step up and right, each labelled with its shape ((512, H/16, W/16) ... (16, H, W))

three dotted curves labelled 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 leave the three CNN slabs and land in grey dashed boxes on the decoder staircase, where a purple encoder slab sits beside a blue decoder slab (feature concatenation)

panel (a) on the left opens one Transformer Layer (Layer Norm, MSA, +, Layer Norm, MLP, +, with residual lines) from 'Embedded Sequence x_p^1 ... x_p^N' to z_1, tied to the green transformer frame by grey dashed lines
two Transformer Layer bars with a vertical ellipsis and '(n = 12)' between them

channels.colour: purple = CNN encoder features (also inside the concatenation boxes, so skip origin is visible), blue = decoder features, green frame = transformer encoder, yellow/orange = transformer sub-layers and projection; arrow colour = operation, keyed (blue Conv3x3 ReLU, green Upsample, yellow segmentation head); output colours = organ classes, unkeyed
channels.shape: 3D slabs = feature maps; rounded bars = layers; circled plus = residual addition; CT images = data
channels.line: coloured block arrows = keyed decoder operations; black dotted arrows = 'Downsample' in the legend, but the same dotted style draws both the CNN's internal downsampling and the long skip curves, so dotted carries two meanings; grey dashed lines = zoom tie
channels.frame: pink rounded frame = CNN; green rounded frame = transformer; grey dashed boxes = concatenation (keyed); cream panel (a) = layer detail

quality.strengths: the hybrid encoder is one vertical column and the decoder one rising staircase, so the U-shape reads from position with every slab carrying its tensor shape; encoder purple reappears inside each concatenation box, so the reader sees which feature is skipped where; real CT input and a coloured segmentation output frame the pipeline; a legend keys arrow colours and the concatenation frame
quality.weaknesses: the dotted line style is keyed as 'Downsample' but also draws the three long skip curves, which sweep across the open space; the transformer, the paper's addition, is a plain stack of two labelled bars no larger than the CNN frame; organ colours in the output are unkeyed

insights.structure: A tall cream inset (a) on the far left expands the transformer layer, while panel (b) runs the CNN (lilac frame) down into the green-framed transformer stack and a diagonal decoder staircase rises to the upper right.
insights.data: The input CT slice sits above the CNN and the coloured-mask CT output at the top-right, with features drawn as translucent 3-D cuboids carrying bold (C, H/k, W/k) shape labels.
insights.emphasis: The transformer stack is the only container with a saturated green outline and the only one opened into a detail panel via grey dashed zoom lines.
insights.flow: Read top-down through the CNN and transformer, rightward along the reshaped bottleneck, then up the decoder staircase via green upsample arrows, with dotted skip curves (1/2, 1/4, 1/8) dropping in from the CNN.
insights.avoid: The dotted skip curves run long diagonal paths across empty space and are labelled only by scale, so which concatenation box each one feeds is hard to trace.

arrangement.units: (b) the main architecture with sub-groups (lilac CNN frame, green transformer frame, dashed concatenation squares); (a) a cream rounded detail inset at the far left, linked by dashed zoom lines
arrangement.inputs_as: a real CT slice above the CNN encoder
arrangement.losses_at: no loss drawn; the decoder ends at a segmentation head arrow into a coloured-mask CT slice at top-right

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
